What is our profit margin by genre?

tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH sales AS (
  SELECT g.GenreId, g.Name AS Genre,
         SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue,
         SUM(t.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS cost
  FROM InvoiceLine il
  JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
  LEFT JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
  GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
)
SELECT GenreId, Genre,
       ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(cost, 2) AS cost,
       ROUND(revenue - cost, 2) AS profit,
       ROUND(CASE WHEN revenue = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (revenue - cost) / revenue END * 100, 2) AS margin_percent
FROM sales
ORDER BY margin_percent DESC;"}
